sources: https://www.camplife.com/campground/stokesville+campground (CampLife booking API for campground 1125: site records and one- and two-night quotes for 2026-10-17, 2026-10-20, 2027-01-26/30, 2027-06-08/12, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: http://stokesvillecampground.com/info/ ('Pull through sites are $50 and have high powered electric with 50, 30 amp RV plugs and 110 plugs, water and sewer (sites P1-P9) Our back in sites have (1) 30 amp RV plug, water and sewer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: RV sites: pull-throughs P1-P9 (CampLife lists P2 at 45 ft, P6 at 40 ft) and back-ins #7-9 and 14-24 (most 'No RVs greater than 28'', RV 8 for pop-ups and campers under 20 ft only, P8 25 ft). Two overflow field sites share a 30-amp pole with no sewer. The rest are tent sites and two rustic cabins. Motorhomes must unhook a towed car before the entrance road (the operator suggests the Stokesville Church lot, 1/4 mile away).

sites.source: http://stokesvillecampground.com/info/ ('RV Sites #7-9,14-24 and P1-P9', 'All Motorhomes with towed vehicles MUST unhook the towed vehicle before you arrive at the entrance') + CampLife site records (maxLength: P2 45, P6 40, RV 17-24 28, P8 25, RV 8 16), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two large bathhouses with hot inside and outside showers, closed December 1 to March 1 each year; a 4-unit bathroom by the pavilion. Swimming hole, kids' fishing lake, playground, on-site mountain bike trails; firewood $7 a bundle.

facilities.source: http://stokesvillecampground.com/info/ ('We have two large bathhouses with hot inside and outside showers', 'All the water is potable') + http://stokesvillecampground.com/ ('Shower Buildings are closed Dec 1st to March 1st annually'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on CampLife, paid in full in advance. RV camping: two-night minimum on weekends; three nights over Memorial Day weekend, July 3-6 and some event weekends (Red Wing Roots, Shenandoah 100).

booking.source: http://stokesvillecampground.com/info/ ('RV Camping – TWO NIGHT MINIMUM on WEEKENDS', 'we require payment in full in advance HERE ON OUR RESERVATION PAGE') + http://stokesvillecampground.com/ ('Memorial Day Weekend – 3 night minimum', 'July 3rd-6th – Freedom 4th – 3 night minimum'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Back-in 30-amp water/sewer sites $40 a night, 50-amp full-hookup pull-throughs $50, before tax; any vehicle with a trailer or camper pays at least $40. Extra vehicles $10 a day. CampLife adds its own $3.50 per booking. Quoted on CampLife for October 2026 through June 2027.

fees.source: http://stokesvillecampground.com/info/ ('Pull through sites are $50', 'back in sites ... cost $40 per night', 'Any vehicle with a trailer or camper is a minimum of $40') + CampLife quotes (one night from 2026-10-20 and 2027-06-08: Back In $43.50, Pull Through $53.50 before tax; two-night Tent quote $33.50 against $18.50 for one shows the $3.50 per-stay charge), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the derived 50A/water/sewer and pull-throughs; added rates $40 back-in to $50 pull-through (operator page + 2026-27 CampLife quotes), sites to 45 ft, showers/potable water, reservable on CampLife with a 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday minimum. Not stated: season (bookable through winter but no statement; showers close Dec 1-Mar 1), site count (113 left derived).
